data.title: HealthStream Raises $40 Million via Private Placement at $29.50; Investor Buys 1.5M Shares
data.description:
HealthStream announced a private placement with WJRJJ Ventures, selling 1,355,932 newly issued shares for approximately $40.0 million at $29.50 per share. In a related transaction, the investor acquired 144,068 shares from CEO Robert A. Frist, Jr. for about $4.25 million, totaling 1.5 million shares. The deal closed on Sep 14, 2026, includes a 12-month standstill, and proceeds will fund product investment, working capital, acquisitions, and other strategic initiatives. HealthStream also granted the investor resale registration rights to facilitate future liquidity.

Agreement 1: HealthStream Raises $40 Million via Private Placement at $29.50; Investor Buys 1.5M Shares

  • Agreement type: Securities Purchase Agreement for private placement of common stock
  • Counterparty: WJRJJ Ventures
  • Signed / Effective: Sep 11 2026 / Sep 14 2026
  • Duration / Termination: N/A
  • Reason: Fund general corporate needs and strategic initiatives

Agreement 2: HealthStream Grants Resale Registration Rights to WJRJJ Ventures for New Shares

  • Agreement type: Registration Rights Agreement for resale of shares
  • Counterparty: WJRJJ Ventures
  • Signed / Effective: Sep 14 2026 / same
  • Duration / Termination: Until resale completed or Rule 144 availability
  • Reason: Provide liquidity path for investor

data.title: Dream Finders Homes Raises $225 Million in Series B Convertible Preferred; Up to $450 Million More at Merger Close
data.description:
Dream Finders Homes entered into Subscription Agreements with institutional investors to issue 225,000 shares of Series B Convertible Preferred Stock for $225.0 million, with a 2.5% original issue discount. Proceeds redeemed all Series A preferred and support general corporate uses, with a further 450,000 Series B shares to be sold at merger close to help fund the Beazer transaction. The preferred carries a 12% cumulative dividend, company redemption rights after year three, and post-year-six conversion features, subject to NYSE shareholder approval limits. Transfer restrictions, protective covenants tied to the credit agreement, and fundamental change rights apply.

Agreement 1: Dream Finders Homes Raises $225 Million in Series B Convertible Preferred; Up to $450 Million More at Merger Close

  • Agreement type: Subscription Agreements for Series B Convertible Preferred Stock
  • Counterparty: Institutional investors
  • Signed / Effective: Sep 14 2026 / Sep 14 2026
  • Duration / Termination: Perpetual preferred; company redemption rights after year three
  • Reason: Refinance preferred stock and fund pending Beazer merger

Agreement 2: Dream Finders Homes Grants Investor Rights Including Board Observers, Standstill and ROFR

  • Agreement type: Investor Rights Agreements
  • Counterparty: Institutional investors
  • Signed / Effective: Sep 14 2026 / Sep 14 2026
  • Duration / Termination: While holders own Series B preferred (standstill: 18 months)
  • Reason: Provide governance rights and protections to new investors

Agreement 3: Dream Finders Homes Agrees to Register Resale of Series B Preferred and Conversion Shares

  • Agreement type: Registration Rights Agreement
  • Counterparty: Institutional investors
  • Signed / Effective: Sep 14 2026 / Sep 14 2026
  • Duration / Termination: Until registered securities are sold or cease to be registrable
  • Reason: Facilitate liquidity for investors via SEC-registered resales

Agreement 4: Dream Finders Homes Secures Voting Support From CEO for Shareholder Approval

  • Agreement type: Voting Support Agreement
  • Counterparty: Patrick Zalupski
  • Signed / Effective: Sep 14 2026 / Sep 14 2026
  • Duration / Termination: Through the vote on Requisite Shareholder Approval
  • Reason: Increase certainty of shareholder approval for conversion shares

Original SEC Filing: Dream Finders Homes, Inc. [ DFH ] - 8-K - Sep. 15, 2026

data.title: TSX subdued at open as inflation worries weigh ahead of Fed decision
data.description:
Canada's main stock index was subdued at open on Tuesday as higher oil prices and surging bond yields kept investors cautious ahead of the Federal Reserve's interest rate decision on Wednesday, while recovery in precious metal prices helped limit losses.

The S&P/TSX Composite Index was down 0.06% at 35.681.31 points at 09:31 a.m. ET.

data.title: Otis CEO Marks to retire next year, succession search underway
data.description:
Otis Worldwide CEO Judy Marks, who helped navigate the elevator maker's transition to a stand-alone company after its 2020 spin-off from United Technologies, is set to retire, the company said on Tuesday.

A committee of independent directors is looking for a successor.

  • Marks, who has been CEO for seven of her nine years at Otis, will continue to lead through July 31, 2027; she will serve as a senior adviser if a successor is named before that.

  • The board committee, supported by executive search firm Spencer Stuart, will consider both internal and external candidates.

  • Prior to leading Otis, Marks was CEO of Siemens USA and Dresser-Rand, a Siemens business focused on energy and industrial equipment.

  • Otis shares fell 1.4% in early trading.

data.title: Algorhythm Completes Transformational $23 Million Acquisition of Leading Renewable Power Plant Developer Serving Fortune 500, AI Data Center and Advanced Manufacturing Clients
data.description:
Key points:
  • Acquired Company Has Over $10 Million in Current Contractual Backlog. 
  • Azure is Generating Positive EBITDA in 2026, and This is Expected to Scale Significantly Over the Next 12 Months.
  • Azure Holds Project Equity Interests in Multiple Power Plants Under Construction with Management-Estimated Net Present Value Exceeding $220 Million.
  • Experienced Team Has Participated in the Design and Construction of 72 Power Generation Facilities Representing 17.5 GW of Generating Capacity.

Fort Lauderdale, FL, Sept. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Algorhythm Holdings, Inc. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: RIME) – a leading business holding company, today announced that it has completed the acquisition of Azure Energy, LLC (“Azure”), a renewable power plant developer based in Charlotte, NC.

The transaction was structured as an asset purchase with total consideration of approximately $23 million, consisting of shares of the Company’s common stock and shares of a new class of preferred stock that will obtain voting rights and become convertible into shares of common stock after shareholder approval for the transaction is obtained.

The acquisition represents a transformational strategic transaction for the Company, establishing the Company in the rapidly expanding U.S. power infrastructure market as artificial intelligence, hyperscale computing and advanced manufacturing drive substantial new demand for reliable power generation.

Azure Energy – Experienced Team, Scaling Contract Revenue & EBITDA, Significant Project Level Equity Stakes

Azure is a leading developer of renewable biomass power generation infrastructure. It was founded in 2025 by Andrew Thompson and Kevin Tangen. Its team consists of some of the most experienced biomass power plant experts in the US today. Collectively, the team has designed and built 72 facilities generating 17.5GW of renewable power to date. Azure Energy has already secured equity participation valued at over $220 million in net present value through multiple power plants under construction in the US today. Azure Energy has significant fee-income consulting revenues that will be receivable under multi-year contracts, and is generating scaling, positive EBITDA.

Azure's current engagements include Fortune 500 companies converting or redeveloping legacy fossil-fuel power facilities with renewable solutions, new AI data center facilities in Tennessee and Louisiana, and advanced manufacturing facilities. Its growing pipeline includes potential data center projects in Oregon, Wyoming and across the southeastern United States, additional Fortune 500 prospects, and government-supported renewable energy projects.

Positioned at the Intersection of Sustainable Power Infrastructure and AI Data Center Growth

The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence and hyperscale computing is creating unprecedented demand for new power infrastructure, and Azure is uniquely positioned to capitalize on this window of opportunity. McKinsey estimates that nearly $7 trillion of cumulative global data center investment will be required by 2030, including approximately $1.3 trillion supporting the power generation and transmission, cooling and electrical infrastructure required for AI data centers.

At the same time, the substantial electricity and water requirements of large-scale data centers are generating increased scrutiny from communities and governments concerned about grid capacity, utility rates, water resources and environmental impact. These concerns are increasingly affecting where and how new data centers can be developed.

Azure's pyrolysis-to-power (“P2P”) technology is designed to address these challenges. Its power plants utilize renewable biomass and waste streams to produce reliable, dispatchable power capable of operating independently from traditional electric grid capacity. This behind-the-meter approach can provide data center developers with dedicated power generation while reducing dependence on constrained local utility infrastructure.

Azure's P2P technology is also designed around sustainability, providing a carbon-neutral power generation pathway while generating millions of gallons of fresh, potable water per day as a byproduct of the power generation process. The Company believes this combination of dedicated power, renewable biomass utilization and internally generated water can substantially reduce the demands a data center places on local power and water resources.

New Members of Executive Team

As part of the transaction, Andrew Thompson, co-founder and Managing Partner of Azure Energy, was appointed Chief Executive Officer and Chairman of the Board of Algorhythm Holdings. Mr. Thompson is a serial entrepreneur with more than 20 years of finance, project finance and energy project development experience. Kevin Tangen, co-founder of Azure Energy, also joined the Company and will drive the engineering and technical teams within the Company. Mr. Tangen has over 40 years of deep technical expertise in the renewable power generation space and is considered a leading expert on Azure’s pyrolysis to power technology

“We are excited to complete this transaction and begin the next phase of building Azure as part of Algorhythm,” commented Andrew Thompson, Managing Partner of Azure Energy. “Our team has spent many years developing and constructing complex power generation projects. We are leaders in the design, construction and supervision of innovative biomass power plants. Our work to date speaks for itself; 72 power plants, 17.5GW delivered to a wide range of satisfied power consumers across the US.”

“Power availability is rapidly becoming one of the defining infrastructure challenges of the AI era,” continued Thompson. “Azure has been built around addressing that challenge with scalable, dispatchable and sustainable power solutions designed to meet the unique requirements of large-scale data centers and other power-intensive customers.”

“Today, as part of Algorythm, we can significantly scale our business, selectively expanding our role in projects where a stronger balance sheet has been the only limiting factor to increasing our revenue opportunity 10x or more. Algorhythm will enable us to take on more projects, accelerate our revenue growth, attract more top-tier talent, and propel us forward, helping us unlock our true value potential. We look forward to providing additional commercial milestone updates in the coming months as we execute on our business model in 2026 and beyond,” concluded Mr. Thompson.

About Algorhythm Holdings

Algorhythm Holdings, Inc. is a leading holding company that owns and operates Azure Energy and SemiCab.

Azure Energy is a leading developer of renewable biomass power generation infrastructure. Azure's uses its pyrolysis-to-power (“P2P”) technology to design power plants that utilize renewable biomass and waste streams to produce reliable, dispatchable power capable of operating independently from traditional electric grid capacity. Azure's P2P technology is also designed around sustainability, providing a carbon-neutral power generation pathway while generating millions of gallons of fresh, potable water per day as a byproduct of the power generation process. Azure has designed and built 72 facilities generating 17.5GW of renewable power to date. For additional information, please go to: https://azure-energy.co/

SemiCab is an AI technology company that has enabled major retailers, brands and transportation providers to address common supply-chain problems globally. Its AI-enabled, cloud-based Collaborative Transportation Platform achieves the scalability required to predict and optimize millions of loads and hundreds of thousands of trucks. For additional information, please go to: http://www.semicab.com.

data.title: Informa TechTarget Launches AI-driven ‘Buyer Intelligence’ Solution to Accelerate B2B GTM Workflows With Actionable, Person-Level Intent Data and Insights
data.description:
Informa TechTarget (Nasdaq: TTGT)—an indispensable partner for B2B intelligence, media, and marketing solutions—today announced the launch of Buyer Intelligence: a holistic, AI skill-enhanced intelligence solution created to transform and accelerate how B2B organizations leverage intent data to fuel their go-to-market (GTM) systems. Built on Informa TechTarget's industry-leading person-level intent data—for which the company was recognized as both a Leader and Customer Favorite in the most recent Forrester Wave™: Intent Data Providers For B2B (Q1, 2025)—Buyer Intelligence integrates powerful AI functionality to accelerate time to insight and action to power a variety of activations for B2B marketing and sales teams.

“As B2B organizations continue to invest in AI functionality for their GTM systems, their outcomes will only be as strong as their inputs. To be an indispensable partner to our customers, Informa TechTarget is delivering something fundamentally unique: an AI-driven, person-level intelligence solution built on the type of high-quality, granular data that our customers’ AI-optimized GTM systems need to be successful,” said Gary Nugent, Chief Executive Officer of Informa TechTarget. “Buyer Intelligence will help deliver better outcomes, fueled by the type of directly observed behavioral data only we can provide.”

AI capabilities embedded in Informa TechTarget’s Buyer Intelligence support use cases including buying group identification, personalized sales messaging, ABM strategy, new customer identification, campaign amplification, and content planning. These AI skills include:

  • Pain Points: AI-surfaced content engagement insights—derived from the articles, videos, webinars, and related content that buyers are actively consuming, reading, and watching—that highlight the specific challenges and business problems that buying group members are researching, and why. Pain Points suggests actions, enables personalized messaging with precision, and reduces prep time for sales calls.

  • Pitch Assist: An always-on intelligence layer which surfaces AI-generated messaging guidance tailored to each account's specific business problems; bridging the gap between intent signals and actionable pitch angles.

  • Persona and ICP Intelligence: Turns live buying signals into a ranked market map of which customer segments are actively in-market now, flagging opportunities to identify new personas and reasons to re-evaluate an Ideal Customer Profile, complete with messaging angles for each.

Based on directly observed signals from permissioned audience members, Buyer Intelligence identifies companies and buyers actively researching solutions and the specific challenges they're seeking to address, enhanced with contextual analysis and recommended messages and actions. The data is sourced exclusively from Informa TechTarget’s global audience of engaged B2B decision-makers—who seek trusted editorial and webinar content to help them make informed purchase decisions—which generates millions of intent and behavioral signals daily.

“Over 20+ years, Informa TechTarget has forged strong relationships with tens of millions of B2B buying group members who trust the expert guidance of our award-winning editorial content and BrightTALK webinar communities. That gives our customers access to signals that simply aren't available anywhere else, and now we're making those buyer insights even more powerful and actionable,” said Mark Picone, Chief Product & Technology Officer of Informa TechTarget. “With the inclusion of purpose-built AI skills like Pain Points, Pitch Assist, and Persona and ICP Intelligence, our customers will be able to unlock even more value from the richest person-level buyer intelligence available in B2B."

In addition to access via Informa TechTarget’s Portal customer platform, Buyer Intelligence is also available via several marketing automation (MAP), customer relationship management (CRM), and account-based marketing (ABM) platforms, as well as AI-ready data clouds and modern data stack solutions.

Informa TechTarget has consistently been recognized as an industry leader in intent data by multiple analysts and reports, including recognition as: a Leader and Customer Favorite in Forrester Wave™: Intent Data Providers For B2B, Q1 2025 (the most recent publication of this report); a Leader in the Frost Radar™: Account-Based Marketing Platforms, by Frost & Sullivan; and a Leader in Research in Action’s Vendor Selection Matrix for Revenue Marketing Automation Platforms, which emphasized its integration of intent intelligence with revenue attribution capabilities.

Learn more about Buyer Intelligence at www.informatechtarget.com/products/buyer-intelligence/.

About Informa TechTarget
Informa TechTarget informs, influences and connects the world's technology buyers and sellers, and aims to be an indispensable partner in driving clients’ go-to-market success. With a vast reach of over 220 highly targeted technology-specific digital properties and approximately 58 million permissioned first-party audience members, Informa TechTarget has a unique understanding of and insight into the technology market.

As a leading provider of market intelligence, industry journalism, brand and demand marketing solutions, content strategy and creation, and exclusive buyer intent data, we deliver expert-led, data-driven, and digitally enabled services that create significant impact and measurable outcomes for our clients. All of this is underpinned by a unique audience data ecosystem and fueled by buyer insights and expertise.

Informa TechTarget is headquartered in Boston, MA and has offices in 19 global locations. For more information, visit informatechtarget.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

data.title: Mastercard Dreamonomics Research Finds U.S. Small Businesses Are Prioritizing Predictable Growth, With the TCS New York City Marathon Showing the Opportunity Major Moments Can Create
data.description:
New North America findings from Mastercard’s Dreamonomics research show small and medium-sized businesses (SMEs) are redefining growth in a more demanding economy, prioritizing stability, preparedness and resilience over rapid expansion.

The findings reinforce a key insight from Mastercard's inaugural global Dreamonomics report: While entrepreneurs remain ambitious, they increasingly want growth that is predictable, protected and easier to manage. As businesses navigate increasingly complex operating environments, they are seeking the insights, intelligence and confidence needed to make smarter decisions and capture opportunity when it emerges.

Why it matters

For small businesses, major events can create sudden increases in customer traffic, spending and operational pressure.

From race weekends and seasonal tourism to holiday shopping periods and major sporting events, growth often arrives in concentrated moments. According to Dreamonomics, entrepreneurs are focused not only on attracting customers, but on ensuring they are prepared to serve them when demand surges.

"Every small business starts with a dream, but turning that dream into sustainable growth requires confidence, preparation and the ability to act when opportunity arrives," said Ginger Siegel, North America Small Business lead at Mastercard. "Small business owners are looking for more than support, they're looking for confidence. By combining economic insights, practical tools and trusted guidance, we're helping entrepreneurs prepare for what's next and realize their potential when demand accelerates.”

What Mastercard is doing

To address this need, Mastercard is releasing Race Ready, a new small business playbook designed for high-traffic moments.

The initiative launches ahead of the 2026 TCS New York City Marathon, where businesses across all five boroughs will welcome hundreds of thousands of runners, spectators and visitors. Combining expert guidance, economic insights and practical business considerations, Race Ready helps entrepreneurs anticipate demand, prepare operations and maximize opportunities during major moments.

Mastercard will also spotlight small businesses along the Marathon route, beginning with LIC Bar in Queens and IndiCo Coffee Co. in Manhattan, using consumer spending and foot-traffic insights to illustrate how local businesses can prepare for increased activity during race weekend.

By the numbers

The Mastercard Economic Institute1 analyzed the impact of the 2025 TCS New York City Marathon on small restaurants and bars along the Marathon Route. The analysis found:

  • 22% spend lift: Small restaurants and bars experienced a 22% boost to spending in 2025, relative to the underlying trend, along the marathon route. This is up from a 15% spend lift in 2023.

  • Peak boost is 40% additional spending: Looking at distribution throughout the day, the peak was a 40% incremental boost at small restaurants and bars.

  • 2 p.m. to 4 p.m. is prime time: More than one-third of Marathon Sunday spending occurs during this two-hour window. Activity begins to build in the late morning, with spending accelerating around 11 a.m.

What's next

The initiative reflects Mastercard's broader commitment to helping small businesses grow with greater confidence through the insights, tools and support they need to prepare for moments of increased demand.

Through Mastercard's partnership with New York Road Runners, the company will spotlight long-standing businesses along the Marathon route and share insights into how entrepreneurs prepare for one of New York City's largest annual surges in consumer activity.

About Mastercard Economics Institute

The Mastercard Economics Institute provides insights into global and local economic trends using advanced analytics and Mastercard's proprietary data assets. Established in 2020, MEI supports businesses, governments and policymakers with economic monitoring services and timely analysis on economic themes including consumer spending, retail and travel trends and other local and global barometers of economic performance. MEI offers valuable perspectives to inform decision-making and promote sustainable growth worldwide through our thought leadership series and through Mastercard’s specialized product offerings.

About Mastercard

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re building a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

1 Aggregated and anonymized 2025 Mastercard transaction data

data.title: Lippert Selects ketteQ as Strategic Partner for Supply Chain Planning
data.description:
Global components manufacturer selects AI-native architecture to support the next phase of its supply chain planning strategy

ATLANTA, Sept. 15, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ketteQ, the supply chain orchestration company powered by Free-Range AI™, today announced that Lippert, a global manufacturer of highly engineered components for the RV, marine, automotive, commercial vehicle, and building products industries, has selected ketteQ as its next-generation supply chain planning platform, based on its current capabilities, future innovation roadmap, and partnership approach, along with the advanced planning potential of Quintus™ AI and the PolymatiQ™ solver. The selection reflects a growing number of companies worldwide exploring how Quintus™ can fundamentally transform their supply chain planning while capturing significant financial and operational value.

After nine years of investment in and customization of its current enterprise planning platform, Lippert began evaluating the capabilities needed to support the next stage of its supply chain planning journey. The company sought a solution that could meet its current planning requirements while offering greater flexibility, continued innovation, and a strong long-term partnership.

Lippert built its evaluation requirements to establish parity with its incumbent system, and ketteQ met every one of them across two structured demonstrations. The engagement was driven by defined technical requirements and direct validation, with Trillium, ketteQ's implementation partner, working alongside Lippert's technical team to discover the architecture and integration throughout the process.

The evaluation ultimately focused on long-term strategic fit and future capabilities. In a later session, Lippert's team watched Quintus™, ketteQ's Free-Range AI™, reason through a live question that no one had prepared in advance. The unscripted response reframed the evaluation: Lippert identified capabilities that aligned with its long-term planning and innovation objectives.

"Lippert's evaluation identified an opportunity to adopt a platform that aligns closely with its future vision for AI-enabled supply chain planning," said Mike Landry, CEO of ketteQ. "Lippert's decision to partner with ketteQ and Quintus™ highlights a move toward AI-native architecture, not AI bolted onto a system that was never designed for it."

Throughout the evaluation, Lippert considered both current planning capabilities and each platform's ability to support future innovation. ketteQ's partnership approach, AI-native architecture, Quintus™ AI, and PolymatiQ™ solver differentiated the solution and aligned with Lippert's vision for more responsive, intelligent supply chain planning.

"When we built our evaluation requirements, we were looking for a platform that could match what we already had," said Ben-Marvin Egel, VP of Supply Chain Planning & Governance, Lippert. "Watching Quintus™ reason through a live question, one nobody had prepared for, showed us the potential to combine advanced planning capabilities with a new level of decision support for Lippert's complex business."

That technical groundwork, paired with what Lippert saw in Quintus™, is behind what the company expects to gain from the move: an open, AI-native architecture designed to enhance visibility, support scalable planning processes, and reduce the need for future customization as the business evolves with a platform built to adapt as Lippert's business changes. Lippert also expects the shift to position it as an early mover in AI-enabled supply chain planning within its industry.

"This decision was about more than replacing a system we had outgrown," said Scott Meiner, Chief Supply Chain Officer, Lippert. "It was about putting a faster, more responsive planning foundation in place—one that strengthens our planning capabilities, supports faster decision-making, and provides a foundation for future innovation as quickly as our business moves."

Lippert expects the shift to give its planning team more room to focus on strategic decisions, with routine, high-volume planning and purchasing work increasingly automated, enabling planners to respond faster to changing conditions.

About ketteQ

ketteQ is the supply chain orchestration company powered by Free-Range AI™. Quintus™, its AI intelligence, is the only supply chain agent that reasons over any question, executes any action, and addresses any use case, unscripted, unconstrained, and fully governed, across Planning Solutions and Execution Solutions, above any ERP or planning platform the customer already runs. Powered by PolymatiQ™, ketteQ's patent-pending agentic solver explores the solution space and returns the optimal answer in seconds. Quintus™ deploys in four to eight weeks with no rip-and-replace. ketteQ was founded in 2018 and has been running AI-native supply chain planning and orchestration in production before the category had a name. For more information, visit ketteQ.com.

About LCI Industries

LCI Industries (), through its Lippert subsidiary, is a global leader in supplying engineered components to the outdoor recreation and transportation markets. We believe our innovative culture, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and dedication to enhancing the customer experience have established Lippert as a reliable partner for both OEM and aftermarket customers. For more information, visit www.lippert.com.
